canonical_units.label: НИ: усилительная частица vs повторяющийся союз НИ… НИ

particle.model: НИ reinforces an already expressed or structurally implied negation.

repeating_conjunction.model: Repeated НИ connects homogeneous members in a negative construction.
repeating_conjunction.example: не слышно ни шорохов, ни голосов

canonical_units.counting_policy: One learner boundary with two functional branches; do not count particle and repeating-conjunction branches again as separate denominator units.
